nodes.label: Installer-app Tech Stack
nodes.rationale: React (Vite) + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS frontend; Zustand for global/auth state, TanStack Query for server-state caching of Supabase data; Supabase (PostgreSQL, Auth, Storage) backend.

nodes.label: Sites Data Model (code, system_type)
nodes.rationale: Sites are identified by 'code' (e.g. SITE-001) and 'client_name' — the earlier 'project_code' column was renamed, so all queries must use 'code'. Creating sites requires the system_type field ('PV', 'BESS', 'PV+BESS', 'OTHER'). Statuses: pending, in_progress, paused, completed.

nodes.label: Role-Based Routing (admin / installer)
nodes.rationale: After Supabase.auth login the profile is read from user_profiles; admin routes to /admin and installer to /mobile via ProtectedRoute, and the root route redirects a logged-in user to their module.

nodes.label: Shared CreateSiteModal Component
nodes.rationale: CreateSiteModal was extracted into src/components/admin/CreateSiteModal.tsx so that site creation has a single code source used by both the Dashboard and the Sites.tsx (all sites) page.

nodes.label: LiveAdminTimer Live Time Monitoring
nodes.rationale: Dashboard 'Šiandien dirba' section uses LiveAdminTimer.tsx which takes the start_time of the open time_entries record (!e.end_time) and counts duration live; if no open entry exists it falls back safely to '0h 0min 0s' (defensive prop checking is a stated project practice).

nodes.label: Silent Time Tracking (Installer UI)
nodes.rationale: Installers are paid per completed work (kW), not per hour, so all time-tracking UI (weeklyHours, daily totals on SiteCard) was removed from the installer view to avoid confusion. Time is still tracked silently: 'PRADĖTI DARBĄ' sets status in_progress and quietly INSERTs a time_entries row; 'PAUZĖ'/'UŽBAIGTI DARBĄ' find the open session and set end_time = now(), so admin-side time accounting stays correct without a visible timer.

nodes.label: Server-Side Sorting by scheduled_start
nodes.rationale: getInstallerSites sorts with .order('scheduled_start', { nullsFirst: false }) on the server. This works because sorting targets the base sites table — Supabase .order() on joined tables previously failed, which had forced client-side Array.sort(). Direction is passed via { ascending }: Today.tsx ascending, Sites.tsx descending; the client-side sort was removed.

nodes.label: Checklist Grouping by Phases
nodes.rationale: In SiteDetail.tsx tasks are grouped into a single 'Darbai' tab by phases (pre, during, post); checkbox changes sync in real time to the site_checklists table, and uploading a photo automatically marks the task complete and attaches a thumbnail preview.

nodes.label: TanStack Query Invalidation Practice
nodes.rationale: After every mutation (pause, site start, etc.) queryClient.invalidateQueries() must be called so lists refresh without a page reload.
